snippet.title: PlayStation - WWF WrestleMania - The Arcade Game (1995)
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
Take on wrestling to the EXTREME with intense action straight from the arcade smash! It's in-your-face mayhem with punishing head-to-head and team matchups! No pain, no game!
